name: Wives Submitting
overview: Scripture teaches that wives are called to submit to their own husbands as an expression of their reverence for the Lord, reflecting a divine order within marriage (Ephesians 5:22). This submission is balanced by the husband's command to love his wife sacrificially, as Christ loved the church, demonstrating selfless care and protection (Ephesians 5:25; Colossians 3:19). While Galatians 3:28 affirms the unity and equality of all believers in Christ regardless of distinctions, the marital roles outlined in Ephesians and Colossians reveal a complementary relationship grounded in mutual respect and Christ-centered love.
